verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state the exact story: 'Assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request. Use comments to refine, iterate, approve and merge—all directly within GitHub Mobile,' plus Agent Tasks management for cloud agent tasks from mobile. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of this specific assign-to-agent flow (community evidence is older and doesn't test this feature).
